answer_1.quote: we ask LLMs to complete three tasks based on the collected dataset: generating references, writing an abstract, and writing a complete literature review based on a given topic.
datasets: 1,105 literature reviews from Annual Reviews across Biology, Chemistry, Mathematics, Physics, Social Science, Technology

answer_2.quote: evaluate the generated results using our proposed metrics... including reference precision, overlap rate, title search rate, NLI scores for factual consistency, ROUGE metrics, and Key Point Recall.

answer_3.quote: we employ TRUE, along with GPT-4o as NLI models for evaluating factual consistency in context; ... For the Review Composition task, we employ GPT-4o as the NLI model

answer_4.quote: 100 LLM-generated references... assessed by three annotators and the final manual results were obtained by majority vote.
answer_4.guideline: To evaluate the reliability of our automatic assessment method for identifying hallucinated references
